job.title: HSE Business Partner
job.description:

job.title: Health and Safety Advisor
job.description:
Zenergy is partnering with a leading infrastructure contractor to recruit Health and Safety Advisors for a major renewable energy and infrastructure project in regional NSW.

These are permanent positions offering competitive remuneration, attractive FIFO/DIDO arrangements and long-term career opportunities across future major infrastructure projects.

About the Role

Reporting to the Health and Safety Manager, you will provide hands-on safety support across a large-scale construction environment, working closely with project management, supervisors, subcontractors and frontline personnel.

You will support safety performance through site inspections, incident investigations, risk assessments, training and ongoing assurance activities, while promoting a positive and proactive safety culture.

These positions will suit practical, approachable safety professionals who enjoy being visible on site, building strong relationships and contributing to the safe delivery of complex construction projects.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide visible, hands-on safety support across construction teams and high-risk site activities.
  • Build strong relationships with project managers, supervisors, subcontractors and frontline personnel to promote a positive safety culture.
  • Conduct incident investigations, risk assessments and corrective action management.
  • Undertake workplace inspections, audits, safety observations and critical control verifications.
  • Review and support the implementation of SWMS, permits and safe systems of work.
  • Develop and deliver toolbox talks, inductions, pre-start meetings and safety communications.
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of project safety management systems and procedures.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with WHS legislation, project requirements and relevant safety standards.
  • Work collaboratively with construction teams to identify operational risks and implement practical safety solutions.
About You
  • Certificate IV, Diploma or tertiary qualification in Work Health and Safety or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience in a Health and Safety Advisor, HSE Advisor, Safety Coordinator or similar position.
  • Ideally 3+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience across civil construction, major infrastructure, utilities, renewable energy, transmission, substations or electrical construction highly regarded.
  • Practical knowledge of high-risk construction activities, incident investigations, risk assessments and contractor management.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build relationships across diverse project teams.
  • A hands-on, approachable attitude and willingness to learn and develop within a supportive safety team.
  • Previous experience working on regional projects, FIFO/DIDO rosters or remote construction sites advantageous.
  • A trades or operational construction background would be highly regarded.
  • Current Australian driver's licence and full Australian working rights.
What's on Offer
  • Permanent employment with a leading international infrastructure contractor.
  • Competitive base salary, negotiable depending on experience, plus superannuation.
  • Living-away-from-home uplift.
  • 2/1 roster with FIFO/DIDO arrangements available from the East Coast.
  • Accommodation and meals provided in a modern, purpose-built camp with excellent recreational facilities.
  • Transport arrangements and on-site vehicle provided.
  • Opportunity to work on a nationally significant renewable energy and infrastructure development.
  • Supportive and experienced safety leadership team, with opportunities for mentoring and professional development.
  • Long-term career opportunities with potential to transition onto future major infrastructure projects.
Next Steps

Apply with your current CV. Applications are reviewed as received.

job.title: WHS Consultant - 6 Month contract
job.description:
A manufacturing business is looking for a seasoned Health & Safety Consultant to come on board for a six-month contract. Based on site at a mid-sized industrial facility, you'll take a practical, boots-on-the-ground approach, collaborating with plant management, operational teams, and shop floor employees to build a stronger safety culture, keep the site compliant, and embed ongoing improvement throughout the operation. Flexible work arrangements will be considered (work either 4 or 5 days a week). 

You'll thrive in this position if you're a self-directed safety practitioner who connects easily with people at every level of the business and can deliver sensible, risk-focused outcomes in a busy production setting.

What you'll be doing:
  • Carrying out audits, inspections, and risk assessments across production, warehouse, and yard areas, pinpointing hazards and proposing practical fixes
  • Helping to write, review, and roll out safety policies, procedures, and safe work instructions that meet current legislation and standards
  • Looking into incidents, near-misses, and reported hazards, then producing root cause analyses and action plans to prevent recurrence
  • Running inductions, toolbox talks, and safety training for staff, contractors, and site visitors
  • Keeping the site aligned with WHS/OHS requirements and acting as the point of contact for regulators when needed
